placeholders.sop_candidates:
WATER-02: Switch off electrical equipment and sockets in the wet area if it is safe to do so.
WATER-04: Move documents, IT equipment and stock away from the water.
WATER-05: Mop up or pump out standing water and dry the area.
WATER-06: Ask maintenance to repair the source of the leak and inspect nearby pipes or roof sections.
WATER-07: Check ceilings, walls and electrical fittings for water damage before reuse.
WATER-08: Watch for mould or odour over the next days and log any follow-up repairs.
GEN-01: Inform your supervisor and the EHS team about this incident.
GEN-02: Preserve evidence: photos, CCTV, and do not disturb the scene unnecessarily.
GEN-03: Collect witness statements while details are fresh.
GEN-04: Schedule a root-cause review and track corrective actions to closure.
